newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil slightly higher on soyoil gains.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil slightly higher on soyoil gains.

text.p: The Malaysian palm oil market was slightly higher after a higher soyoil futures overnight helped sentiment slightly, traders said.

But trading was fairly cautious with traders concerned over the March stock data yesterday. "Players are still digesting the PORLA's stock data which was far below market estimates," a trader said. Malaysia's Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) put end-March stock at 689,633 tonnes, against trade estimates of 725,000-730,000 tonnes. At 033 GMT, June futures contract rose two ringgit to 1,261 ringgit ($502.19) a tonne. --Tan Lee Lee -(603-230-7510) ($1=2.5110 ringgit)
